subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: Which stable identity should iOS Remote Domain mode authenticate after normal platform CA validation: the paired gateway identity, the TLS leaf certificate, or CA/hostname trust alone?
rationale: Leaf pinning is incompatible with valid anycast rotation, but removing the additional identity check entirely could weaken the security assumptions around pairing and credential reuse; repository policy requires explicit owner judgment for this boundary.

options.title: Pin paired gateway identity
options.body: Use CA and hostname validation for transport, then persist a stable gateway identity established during trusted pairing and prompt only when that identity changes.

options.title: Keep leaf pinning
options.body: Retain the existing boundary and explicitly declare rotating reverse-proxy and anycast endpoints unsupported.

options.title: Use CA trust only
options.body: Rely solely on platform CA and hostname validation for Remote Domain mode, accepting the reduced additional TOFU protection.

recommendation.title: Pin paired gateway identity
recommendation.body: Use CA and hostname validation for transport, then persist a stable gateway identity established during trusted pairing and prompt only when that identity changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covers the iOS gateway connection and pairing lifecycle closest to this decision surface.
